answer: Each identity's usable standing is released only after a sequential, non-transferable custody period, and the release rate is super-linear in how many identities an operator runs, so a fleet cannot mature faster than one identity at a time. The cost of one more head is paid in full and is never amortised across the fleet. The sonnet is the serial tenure, the crystal the custody window that must elapse, and the jade the standing released at the end of it; the sonnet is personal, the crystal is not skippable, and the jade cannot be inherited by a sibling.
